params.caption: 🎮 Helldivers 2 hotfix will let harmless cosmetic mods back in Arrowhead's switch to a stronger anti-cheat also blocked many mods, and players answered with another wave of negative Steam reviews. The studio now plans a hotfix that should allow purely cosmetic mods while keeping cheats out. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 02:29 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 🛠️ React if you mod your games · 💬 Fair fix or too little, too late? #Helldivers2 #PCGaming #GamingNews
